n: 30" Double Wall Oven with No Preheat + Air Fry
desc: Unleash your culinary skills with the Frigidaire 30'' Double Wall Oven and its Total Convection feature. Boasting 10.6 Cu. Ft. of Total Capacity, split between a 5.3 Cu. Ft. Lower Oven and a 5.3 Cu. Ft. Upper Oven, this appliance offers ample space for all your cooking needs.
hl: Gives you maximum versatility in the kitchen, powering cooking modes like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast and more!
Eliminates time wasted waiting on your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to meal time, in no time.
ReadyCook™ Air Fry Tray is included
For perfectly crispy and delicious Air Fry results.
With Steam Bake, steam evenly circulates throughout the oven cavity, resulting in breads and muffins that rise higher and are light and fluffy.
Monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.

We promise that your new 30" Frigidaire® Professional double wall oven will fit your existing cabinet cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you up to $300 for cabinet modification costs.
